files.name: conductor
files.title: Conductor: deliver any project, with evidence
files.description: One entry point for delivering any project, software, physical, service or hybrid, from nothing, a single word, an idea, an existing build or a live product, to an accepted result, and for handing over whatever must keep running. It classifies the project, runs a control loop of established project responsibilities (objective and acceptance, deliverables and work, owners, dependencies and resources, execution within authority, verification and validation, change, handover or closure), keeps one authoritative set of work records in the project's own tool, and never counts work as done without evidence about the actual result and an accountable verifier. Focused guidance loads only when the project needs it.

files.name: conductor-guidance-product
files.title: Product: what it is for, and reaching the people it is for
files.description: Load for every project. It covers the objective and how it is measured, what it takes to make the idea happen, the areas the product needs, the journeys that must never fail, translating requests, releasing to people, and hearing back.

files.name: conductor-guidance-planning
files.title: Planning: deliverables, work, dependencies, schedule and resources
files.description: Every project has work to choose and records to keep, so read at least §Choosing methods by need and §Work records in the project's tool on every project. Read the rest when there are dependencies, dates, shared resources, risks, or changes to agreed scope.

files.name: conductor-guidance-decisions
files.title: Decisions: choosing with evidence, and recording it
files.description: Load for any choice that matters: a platform, supplier, part, provider, library, venue, design, route or tool; any decision that would be costly to reverse; and whenever a recorded decision's reopening condition fires. Decisions are recorded as ADRs.

files.name: conductor-guidance-design
files.title: Design: what people and agents see, hear and operate
files.description: Load whenever the output has anything people or agents meet: screens, a command line, an API, notifications, a voice, a device's controls, lights and sounds, packaging, manuals, signage, a venue's flow.

files.name: conductor-guidance-quality
files.title: Quality: the bar a result must meet, and how it is checked
files.description: Load when setting or checking what "good enough to hand over" means, for any kind of output: software, a physical product or installation, a service, an event, a document. It also holds the rules for reviewing any work, including your own.

files.name: conductor-guidance-software
files.title: Software: building, checking and delivering code
files.description: Load when the output or the work includes software. Most sections are about the ways agents specifically fail: work that reads as finished and is not, tests that cannot fail, pipelines that are green while checking nothing, setup that reports success while broken.

files.name: conductor-guidance-physical
files.title: Physical work: products, installations, devices and actions on the world
files.description: Load when the output includes anything physical (a device, a product made or fitted, an installation, equipment), or when the work issues commands that move, heat, dispense, spend or send: actuators, relays, motors, valves, heaters, robots, vehicles, instruments, machine tools, building controls, and services behind an API that ship, pay, dispense, dispatch or message a person.

files.name: conductor-guidance-service
files.title: Service and creative work: events, films, documents, training and delivered services
files.description: Load when the output is delivered by people rather than shipped as a product: an event, a film or video, a publication, a translation, a course, a consultation, a campaign, a service performed for a client.

files.name: conductor-guidance-operations
files.title: Operations: keeping what runs working, and getting better
files.description: Load for anything that keeps running after delivery (a service, an installation, a product in people's hands, a recurring event), and whenever something live fails the people who use it. Operations belong to a named operator.

files.name: conductor-guidance-autonomy
files.title: Autonomy: agents, harnesses and unattended work
files.description: Load when the work is done by an agent that does not yet have a working harness, when it will run unattended or for long stretches, when several agents share the work, or when choosing which agent does which work.

files.name: conductor-guidance-confidentiality
files.title: Confidentiality: keeping the work where the owner chose
files.description: Load when the project is private, proprietary or offline, or when any of its work (the idea, code, data, designs, customer names, even the fact that it exists) must not leave. Load it before anything is sent anywhere: a search, a remote model, a hosted tool, a forum post.

files.name: conductor-template-adr
files.title: Decision record (ADR) template
files.description: One file per decision, numbered in order, kept where the project keeps its documents (often docs/decisions/).

files.name: conductor-template-handover
files.title: Handover note template
files.description: For anything that keeps running after a project closes, or when a project changes hands. Kept with the project's records; the receiving operator confirms each section by walking it, not by reading it.
